speaker: gauge
text: This manhole cover is round. I'll make it square, to line up with the paving.

speaker: fitz
text:
The lid rests on a lip, so the hole is a bit smaller. Tip a square diagonally, and it can slip through.
A circle is the same width every way. So it can't fall in.

speaker: fitz
text: No corners to line up. And crews can roll it instead of lifting it. Some places use square ones, though.

speaker: gauge
text: Ooh, what else is built weird? Subscribe and let's find out.
